full_text_en:
Agricultural Bank of China, Xining Branch, Eastern Suburb Office v. China Trust and Investment Corporation — dispute over bank acceptance draft

Appellant (Defendant at First Instance, Counterclaim Plaintiff): China Trust and Investment Corporation.

Legal Representative: Yang Xiufang, General Manager of the company.

Agent ad litem: Zhang Xuebing, Chang Jian, lawyers from China Legal Affairs Center.

Appellee (Plaintiff at First Instance, Counterclaim Defendant): Agricultural Bank of China, Xining Branch, Eastern Suburb Office.

Legal Representative: Sun Ping, Director of the office.

Agent ad litem: Zhang Yongge, Senior Accountant of Agricultural Bank of China, Qinghai Branch.

Agent ad litem: Wang Shunkui, lawyer of Qinghai Provincial Economic Law Firm.

Third Party at First Instance: Xining Chengdong Haiyun Trading Market.

Legal Representative: Ma Haiyun, Manager of the market.

Appellant China Trust and Investment Corporation (hereinafter referred to as CTIC) appealed to the Supreme People's Court against the Civil Judgment (Qing Gao Fa Jing [1992] No. 14) of the Qinghai High People's Court regarding a dispute over a bank acceptance draft. The Supreme People's Court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the procedure of second instance, and upon trial, found the following facts:

On September 4, 1990, the Agricultural Bank of China, Xining Branch, Eastern Suburb Office (hereinafter referred to as ABC Eastern Suburb Office), for the purpose of attracting funds from Zhongnan Aviation Enterprise Group (hereinafter referred to as Zhongnan Group), issued 10 bank acceptance drafts each with a face value of RMB 5,000,000, of which 6 drafts totaling RMB 30,000,000 had the payee as PLA 9560 Factory, a subordinate enterprise of Zhongnan Group. ABC Eastern Suburb Office also issued 3 confirmation letters without designated payees, and the draft numbers indicated in the confirmation letters were exactly the same as those of the drafts. Agricultural Bank of China, Xining Branch and ABC Eastern Suburb Office respectively affixed their official seals on the confirmation letters. In mid-September of the same year, Lin Jingxuan, the contractor of Zhongnan Group, and Jiang Lin, director of the group's Beijing Office, contacted CTIC for a loan and presented relevant loan application materials including the legal representative certificate, business license, the contract for contracting Zhongnan Group, and the group's operating profit statement, detailed statement, and balance sheet. Because the superior unit of Zhongnan Group, the Guangzhou Air Force Enterprise Administration, was not qualified to guarantee the loan, Lin Jingxuan proposed to use bank acceptance drafts totaling RMB 20,000,000 issued by ABC Eastern Suburb Office with the payee being PLA 9560 Factory as loan collateral, and handed the drafts to CTIC, with draft numbers X16784780, X16784781, X16784784, X16784785. On the 14th of the same month, the lender and borrower signed a "RMB Loan Contract," stipulating that CTIC would grant a working capital loan of RMB 20,000,000 to Zhongnan Group, with a monthly interest rate of 9.36‰, and a term of 8 months (from September 14, 1990 to May 16, 1991). Lin Jingxuan of Zhongnan Group and Ren Quansheng, Deputy General Manager of CTIC, respectively signed the contract; the borrower affixed the official seals of Zhongnan Group and PLA 9560 Factory, and the lender affixed the official seal of CTIC. After the contract was signed, CTIC, considering that Zhongnan Group was poorly managed and concerned that it would be unable to repay the loan upon maturity, proposed to change the payee of the bank acceptance drafts used as collateral from PLA 9560 Factory to CTIC. On the 20th of the same month, after negotiation, CTIC and Zhongnan Group added a guarantee clause to the original loan contract: "The borrower shall issue bank acceptance drafts with the lender as the payee as collateral. The borrower guarantees to issue the bank acceptance drafts within 15 days after the loan is made. If overdue, the lender shall impose a daily penalty of 0.5‰ on the borrower. First, a loan of RMB 5,000,000 shall be granted, and after the drafts are received, another RMB 15,000,000 shall be granted." On the 27th of the same month, Deng Xihui, Vice Chairman of the Board of Directors of Zhongnan Group, went to Xining and proposed to ABC Eastern Suburb Office that it must issue bank acceptance drafts of RMB 20,000,000 with CTIC as the payee before Zhongnan Group could attract funds for ABC Eastern Suburb Office. On October 1 of the same year, Li Lixiang, Deputy Manager of the Credit Department of CTIC, Lin Jingxuan of Zhongnan Group, and Jiang Lin together went to Xining and requested ABC Eastern Suburb Office to change the payee of the bank acceptance drafts from PLA 9560 Factory to CTIC. That evening, Li Lixiang showed Liu Nailing, Deputy Director of ABC Eastern Suburb Office, a bank draft of RMB 9,760,000 issued by CTIC to PLA 9560 Factory on September 25 of the same year. On October 3 of the same year, ABC Eastern Suburb Office issued bank acceptance drafts with CTIC as the payee, totaling RMB 20,000,000, with draft numbers: X16858015, X16858016, and the maturity date being July 3, 1991. Immediately thereafter, Su Yuming, Director of ABC Eastern Suburb Office, and Liu Nailing, Deputy Director, handed over the second copies of the above two bank acceptance drafts to Li Lixiang in Lanzhou City. Li Lixiang handed the bank draft of RMB 9,760,000 to Lin Jingxuan. On October 7, Jiang Lin, in Guangzhou City, took the third copies (payment copies) of the bank acceptance drafts issued on October 3 from Liu Nailing, delivered them to CTIC in Beijing, and at the same time retrieved from CTIC the bank acceptance drafts with PLA 9560 Factory as the payee totaling RMB 20,000,000 and returned them to Liu Nailing. As of October 3, CTIC had granted a total of RMB 19,520,000 in working capital loans to Zhongnan Group, directly deducting a handling fee of RMB 480,000 at the time of loan disbursement. After obtaining the loan, Zhongnan Group transferred RMB 6,500,000 of it into the account of Xining Chengdong Haiyun Trading Market (hereinafter referred to as Haiyun Market) at ABC Eastern Suburb Office.

After the loan matured, CTIC failed to recover the loan principal and interest from Zhongnan Group. Upon learning of this, ABC Eastern Suburb Office wrote to CTIC urging it to accelerate the collection of the loan. CTIC requested ABC Eastern Suburb Office to honor the payment of the bank acceptance drafts upon maturity. Accordingly, on June 27, 1991, ABC Eastern Suburb Office filed a lawsuit with the Qinghai High People's Court, requesting a declaration that the bank acceptance drafts of RMB 20,000,000 it had issued were invalid. During the defense period, CTIC filed a counterclaim, requesting ABC Eastern Suburb Office to immediately pay the matured bank acceptance draft amounts and compensate for losses incurred due to the failure to honor the drafts upon maturity. After review, the court found that the outcome of the case had a legal interest relationship with Haiyun Market, and therefore, pursuant to Article 56(2) of the Civil Procedure Law, notified Haiyun Market to participate in the proceedings as a third party.

The Qinghai High People's Court held in its trial: CTIC's loan to Zhongnan Group should have been secured by endorsing and transferring the bank acceptance drafts of RMB 20,000,000 with PLA 9560 Factory as the payee as collateral for the loan. However, CTIC used bank acceptance drafts with itself as the payee as collateral, thus forming a legal relationship of mortgage guarantee by bank acceptance drafts between ABC Eastern Suburb Office and CTIC. CTIC, knowing that it could not recover the huge loan upon maturity and in order to obtain a handling fee, neither presented the loan contract to ABC Eastern Suburb Office nor explicitly expressed the intention to request ABC Eastern Suburb Office to provide a guarantee, but jointly with Zhongnan Group requested ABC Eastern Suburb Office to issue bank acceptance drafts without underlying commodity transactions. Both CTIC and ABC Eastern Suburb Office were at fault for the invalidity of the mortgage guarantee by bank acceptance drafts, and the rights established by the parties on the collateral should be correspondingly invalid. The court ruled: 1. The mortgage guarantee by bank acceptance drafts issued by ABC Eastern Suburb Office was invalid, and CTIC shall return the two bank acceptance drafts (draft numbers X16858015, X16858016) to ABC Eastern Suburb Office within 10 days after this judgment takes effect; 2. ABC Eastern Suburb Office shall compensate CTIC for loan losses of RMB 6,510,000; the case acceptance fee of RMB 110,010 shall be borne equally by ABC Eastern Suburb Office and CTIC, each paying RMB 55,005, and the counterclaim acceptance fee of RMB 110,010 shall be borne by CTIC.

CTIC, dissatisfied with the original judgment, appealed to the Supreme People's Court, claiming: The original judgment omitted the fact that before the appellee issued the bank acceptance drafts with the appellant as the beneficiary, the appellee had already delivered the bank acceptance drafts with PLA 9560 Factory as the payee to the appellant as collateral for the loan. The original finding that the mortgage guarantee was invalid, leading to the corresponding invalidity of the rights established by the parties on the collateral, has no legal basis. The appellant cannot be responsible for the causal relationship of the prior party to the instrument, and the appellee should honor the face amount of the drafts upon maturity. ABC Eastern Suburb Office argued: It cannot be legally established that the appellant used property in its own possession as collateral for its debtor. The appellee's intention from beginning to end was to provide a credit guarantee for attracting funds, and no words such as "pledge" or "mortgage" were noted on the drafts. The appellant, knowing that it had no commodity transaction relationship with Haiyun Market, jointly induced our side with Zhongnan Group and should bear the primary responsibility for the loan losses.

The Supreme People's Court held: Zhongnan Group applied for a loan from CTIC, using the bank acceptance drafts totaling RMB 20,000,000 issued by the appellee ABC Eastern Suburb Office for the purpose of attracting funds, with PLA 9560 Factory, a subordinate enterprise of Zhongnan Group, as the payee, as collateral for the loan, and signed a "RMB Loan Contract" with the appellant CTIC, forming a civil legal relationship of a loan secured by mortgage of bank acceptance drafts. The appellee, at the request of Zhongnan Group and the appellant, changed the payee of the bank acceptance drafts from PLA 9560 Factory to the appellant, and re-issued two bank acceptance drafts, with draft numbers X16858015 and X16858016, totaling RMB 20,000,000, with the appellant as the payee, thereby forming a legal relationship of bank acceptance drafts, i.e., a negotiable instrument relationship, between the appellee and the appellant. Since a negotiable instrument is a non-causative security and a literal security, once the negotiable instrument relationship is established, it is separated from the causal relationship of the acquisition of the instrument. Regardless of whether the causal relationship exists or is valid, it does not affect the validity of the instrument itself. Upon investigation, the two bank acceptance drafts issued and accepted by the appellee on October 3, 1990, with draft numbers X16858015 and X16858016, had complete elements; the appellant acquired the instruments without bad faith and paid adequate consideration. Therefore, the above two negotiable instruments are both legal and valid. The appellee, as the debtor of the bank acceptance drafts in this case, is obligated to unconditionally honor the face amount upon maturity and may not refuse payment on grounds of civil legal relationships outside the instrument. The appellee's contentions that the legal relationship of the above two bank acceptance drafts as mortgage loans cannot be established and that the appellant induced it to issue bank acceptance drafts without underlying commodity transactions are contrary to legal principles. The appellant, as the payee and holder of the bank acceptance drafts in this case, has the right to request the appellee ABC Eastern Suburb Office to honor the draft amounts upon maturity. Its appeal grounds are well-founded and should be sustained. The original third party, Haiyun Market, having received RMB 6,500,000 deposited by Zhongnan Group, may pay the appellee ABC Eastern Suburb Office in accordance with the civil legal relationship of attracting funds agreed between the appellee and Zhongnan Group. The appellant CTIC, as a trust and investment institution, collected a handling fee of RMB 480,000 from Zhongnan Group when lending its own credit funds, which violated the regulation that banks and financial institutions shall not charge handling fees in addition to loan interest, and should be refunded. Since Zhongnan Group has been declared bankrupt and the bankruptcy proceedings have concluded, the RMB 480,000 may be directly refunded to the appellee. The original judgment found the facts clearly, but in its reasoning, it overlooked the non-causative nature of negotiable instruments, confusing the special legal relationship of instruments with ordinary civil legal relationships, thereby reaching the conclusion that "both CTIC and ABC Eastern Suburb Office were at fault for the invalidity of the mortgage guarantee by bank acceptance drafts, and the rights established by the parties on the collateral should be correspondingly invalid," which is clearly erroneous and should be corrected. Accordingly, pursuant to Article 84(2) of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the PRC, which provides that "a creditor has the right to require the debtor to perform its obligations in accordance with the terms of the contract or in accordance with the provisions of the law," and Article 153(1)(ii) of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, the Supreme People's Court ruled on November 11, 1993 as follows:

I. The Civil Judgment (Qing Gao Fa Jing [1992] No. 14) of the Qinghai High People's Court dated April 20, 1992 is set aside;

II. The bank acceptance drafts issued by Agricultural Bank of China, Xining Branch, Eastern Suburb Office on October 3, 1990, with draft numbers X16858015 and X16858016, are valid. Agricultural Bank of China, Xining Branch, Eastern Suburb Office shall honor the face amount of RMB 20,000,000 recorded on the two bank acceptance drafts to China Trust and Investment Corporation;

III. Agricultural Bank of China, Xining Branch, Eastern Suburb Office shall pay to China Trust and Investment Corporation interest losses and penalty interest totaling RMB 6,289,920 (interest calculated from July 3, 1991 to November 3, 1993);

IV. Xining Chengdong Haiyun Trading Market shall pay RMB 6,500,000 to Agricultural Bank of China, Xining Branch, Eastern Suburb Office;

V. The handling fee of RMB 480,000 and interest of RMB 194,088.96 collected by China Trust and Investment Corporation at the time of loan disbursement shall be directly paid to Agricultural Bank of China, Xining Branch, Eastern Suburb Office (interest calculated from October 30, 1990 to October 30, 1993);

The first-instance case acceptance fee and counterclaim acceptance fee of RMB 220,020 shall be borne by the appellee Agricultural Bank of China, Xining Branch, Eastern Suburb Office; the second-instance case acceptance fee of RMB 110,010 shall be borne by the appellee Agricultural Bank of China, Xining Branch, Eastern Suburb Office.
